validation_error.title: Validation Error
validation_error.description: Request body or query failed schema or field validation.

forbidden.title: Forbidden
forbidden.description: Authenticated principal lacks permission for this resource or plane.

not_found.title: Not Found
not_found.description: Generic resource not found when no more specific code applies.

conflict.title: Conflict
conflict.description: Request conflicts with current resource state.

bad_request.title: Bad Request
bad_request.description: Malformed or semantically invalid request that is not a field-validation failure.

payload_too_large.title: Payload Too Large
payload_too_large.description: Request body or uploaded file exceeds the configured size limit.

rate_limit_exceeded.title: Rate Limit Exceeded
rate_limit_exceeded.description: Too many requests; wait and retry.

not_implemented.title: Not Implemented
not_implemented.description: Requested capability is not implemented on this service.

internal_error.title: Internal Error
internal_error.description: Unexpected server failure. Detail is generic; stacks stay in logs.

service_unavailable.title: Service Unavailable
service_unavailable.description: Service or a required dependency is temporarily unavailable (e.g. readiness checks).

bad_gateway.title: Bad Gateway
bad_gateway.description: Upstream dependency returned an invalid or unsuccessful response.

batch_not_found.title: Batch Not Found
batch_not_found.description: Ingest batch id does not exist.

run_not_found.title: Run Not Found
run_not_found.description: Ingestion run id does not exist.

step_not_found.title: Step Not Found
step_not_found.description: Ingestion run step id does not exist.

source_not_found.title: Source Not Found
source_not_found.description: Source document referenced by the request does not exist.

source_not_uploaded.title: Source Not Uploaded
source_not_uploaded.description: Source document is not in uploaded state and cannot be queued for ingest without override.

source_document_not_found.title: Source Document Not Found
source_document_not_found.description: Source document id does not exist.

unknown_stage.title: Unknown Stage
unknown_stage.description: Requested pipeline stage name is not recognized.

merge_override_not_primary.title: Merge Override Not Primary
merge_override_not_primary.description: Override-merge requires the dual-path primary module (the row that references a secondary).

merge_override_not_review_pending.title: Merge Override Not Review Pending
merge_override_not_review_pending.description: Override-merge is only allowed while the primary module is review_pending.

merge_override_secondary_unavailable.title: Merge Override Secondary Unavailable
merge_override_secondary_unavailable.description: The secondary merge module is missing or no longer review_pending.

merge_override_source_unavailable.title: Merge Override Source Unavailable
merge_override_source_unavailable.description: The matched source module for the dual-path merge is missing.

merge_split_not_primary.title: Merge Split Not Primary
merge_split_not_primary.description: Split-merge requires the dual-path primary module (the row that references a secondary).

merge_split_not_review_pending.title: Merge Split Not Review Pending
merge_split_not_review_pending.description: Split-merge is only allowed while the primary module is review_pending.

merge_split_secondary_unavailable.title: Merge Split Secondary Unavailable
merge_split_secondary_unavailable.description: The secondary merge module is missing or no longer review_pending.

duplicate_content.title: Duplicate Content
duplicate_content.description: Upload or start-ingest blocked because content already exists (or every item in the batch was a duplicate / already ingested without override).

invalid_cardinality_targets.title: Invalid Cardinality Targets
invalid_cardinality_targets.description: Ingest cardinality / target module configuration is invalid.

concurrent_run.title: Concurrent Run
concurrent_run.description: Another ingest run already claims this work; retry later or wait for completion.

step_not_failed.title: Step Not Failed
step_not_failed.description: Retry was requested for a step that is not in a failed state.

retry_not_allowed.title: Retry Not Allowed
retry_not_allowed.description: This step or stage cannot be retried in its current state.

candidate_required.title: Candidate Required
candidate_required.description: Operation requires a module candidate id that was not provided.

chunk_required.title: Chunk Required
chunk_required.description: Operation requires a source chunk that was not provided.

chunk_id_invalid.title: Chunk Id Invalid
chunk_id_invalid.description: Provided chunk id is malformed or does not belong to the run.

module_id_missing.title: Module Id Missing
module_id_missing.description: Operation requires a module id that was not provided.

fusion_sources_missing.title: Fusion Sources Missing
fusion_sources_missing.description: Cross-source fusion requires source documents that are missing or incomplete.

module_version_conflict.title: Module Version Conflict
module_version_conflict.description: Optimistic concurrency failure on module edit; refetch latest and retry with expected_version.

object_not_found.title: Object Not Found
object_not_found.description: Object-storage key or file object does not exist.

filename_required.title: Filename Required
filename_required.description: Upload or ingest requires a non-empty filename.

prompt_not_found.title: Prompt Not Found
prompt_not_found.description: Admin prompt id does not exist.

config_not_found.title: Config Not Found
config_not_found.description: Named admin config key does not exist.

module_lifecycle_error.title: Module Lifecycle Error
module_lifecycle_error.description: Module lifecycle transition is not allowed from the current state.

module_family_not_assignable.title: Module Family Not Assignable
module_family_not_assignable.description: Module family cannot be assigned in its current lifecycle or tip state.

gap_link_error.title: Gap Link Error
gap_link_error.description: Linking or unlinking behavioural gaps to a module failed.

badge_not_found.title: Badge Not Found
badge_not_found.description: Badge id does not exist or is soft-deleted.

badge_name_conflict.title: Badge Name Conflict
badge_name_conflict.description: An active badge with the same name already exists.

badge_domain_invalid.title: Badge Domain Invalid
badge_domain_invalid.description: Badge domain is missing/invalid, or does not already exist on any module.

badge_sequence_conflict.title: Badge Sequence Conflict
badge_sequence_conflict.description: An active badge with the same sequence already exists.

badge_module_not_published.title: Badge Module Not Published
badge_module_not_published.description: One or more module_ids are missing or not in published lifecycle status.

hierarchy_division_not_found.title: Hierarchy Division Not Found
hierarchy_division_not_found.description: Division id does not exist for the selected tenant.

hierarchy_district_not_found.title: Hierarchy District Not Found
hierarchy_district_not_found.description: District id does not exist for the selected tenant.

hierarchy_upazila_not_found.title: Hierarchy Upazila Not Found
hierarchy_upazila_not_found.description: Upazila id does not exist for the selected tenant or district.

hierarchy_upazila_invalid.title: Hierarchy Upazila Invalid
hierarchy_upazila_invalid.description: Upazila assignment violates district or parent upazila constraints.

hierarchy_user_not_found.title: Hierarchy User Not Found
hierarchy_user_not_found.description: Hierarchy user id does not exist for the selected tenant.

hierarchy_user_conflict.title: Hierarchy User Conflict
hierarchy_user_conflict.description: A hierarchy user with the same externally supplied id already exists.

hierarchy_parent_invalid.title: Hierarchy Parent Invalid
hierarchy_parent_invalid.description: Parent/role/district/tenant tree rules were violated (AM→PM→SK, same district and tenant).

hierarchy_role_mismatch.title: Hierarchy Role Mismatch
hierarchy_role_mismatch.description: Unsupported or mismatched hierarchy role value.

hierarchy_auth_failed.title: Hierarchy Auth Failed
hierarchy_auth_failed.description: Authenticated SPICE user is missing from the hierarchy table or role names do not exactly match the hierarchy row.

hierarchy_import_invalid.title: Hierarchy Import Invalid
hierarchy_import_invalid.description: Hierarchy CSV/XLSX import failed validation (bad headers, empty cells, size/row limits, or intra-file conflicts such as disagreeing name/role/parent/district for the same user id).

chw_id_required.title: Chw Id Required
chw_id_required.description: Request requires a community health worker (CHW) id.

user_id_missing.title: User Id Missing
user_id_missing.description: Authenticated context is missing a user id required for this operation.

tenant_mismatch.title: Tenant Mismatch
tenant_mismatch.description: Resource tenant does not match the authenticated principal's tenant.

tenant_id_required.title: Tenant Id Required
tenant_id_required.description: Legacy spice 20006: a tenant id was required. Coaching-platform selects tenant from authenticate userDetail.country.tenantId instead of the TenantId header; missing country tenant yields not_authenticated.

tenant_permission_denied.title: Tenant Permission Denied
tenant_permission_denied.description: Legacy spice 20005: selected tenant was not in organizationIds. Coaching-platform no longer membership-checks the country tenant from authenticate.

ai_runtime_unreachable.title: Ai Runtime Unreachable
ai_runtime_unreachable.description: Platform could not reach ai-runtime (transport/timeout). Retry may help.

ai_runtime_error.title: Ai Runtime Error
ai_runtime_error.description: ai-runtime or upstream model provider returned an error.

empty_embedding.title: Empty Embedding
empty_embedding.description: Embedding provider returned an empty vector.

empty_transcript.title: Empty Transcript
empty_transcript.description: Transcription provider returned an empty transcript.

unsupported_mime_type.title: Unsupported Mime Type
unsupported_mime_type.description: Media MIME type is not supported for this operation.

invalid_base64.title: Invalid Base64
invalid_base64.description: Media payload is not valid base64.

embedding_dimension_mismatch.title: Embedding Dimension Mismatch
embedding_dimension_mismatch.description: Embedding vector length does not match the configured store dimension.

object_storage_error.title: Object Storage Error
object_storage_error.description: Object storage upload, download, or delete failed.

analytics_unavailable.title: Analytics Unavailable
analytics_unavailable.description: Analytics backend (e.g. ClickHouse) is unavailable for this request.

coaching_rag_error.title: Coaching Rag Error
coaching_rag_error.description: Coaching RAG query pipeline failed after retrieval or generation.

internal_token_invalid.title: Internal Token Invalid
internal_token_invalid.description: Internal service-to-service auth token is missing or invalid.

pipeline_crashed.title: Pipeline Crashed
pipeline_crashed.description: Ingest pipeline worker crashed while processing a run.
pipeline_crashed.user_message: Processing was interrupted unexpectedly. Please retry the ingestion.
pipeline_crashed.action_hint: Retry the ingestion from the admin dashboard.

stage_failed.title: Stage Failed
stage_failed.description: A generic pipeline stage failed without a more specific code.
stage_failed.user_message: Something went wrong while processing this file. Try re-uploading or contact support if the problem persists.
stage_failed.action_hint: Re-upload the file or retry the ingestion.

extract_failed.title: Extract Failed
extract_failed.description: Source extract stage failed, including when extracted or transcribed text is empty or below the configured minimum character threshold.
extract_failed.user_message: We couldn't extract content from this file. Try re-exporting it from the original source.
extract_failed.action_hint: Re-export the document or media from the original application and upload again.

identify_failed.title: Identify Failed
identify_failed.user_message: We couldn't identify training modules in this document. Try a document with clearer sections or headings.
identify_failed.action_hint: Use a document with clearer headings and section structure, then retry.

identify_no_candidates.title: Identify No Candidates
identify_no_candidates.description: Module identify stage completed without emitting any candidates.
identify_no_candidates.user_message: We couldn't find any training modules in this document. Try a document with clearer sections or headings.
identify_no_candidates.action_hint: Use a document with clearer headings and section structure, then retry.

draft_failed.title: Draft Failed
draft_failed.user_message: We couldn't draft module cards for one or more candidates. Try retrying or reviewing the source document.
draft_failed.action_hint: Review the source document and retry drafting from the admin dashboard.

fusion_failed.title: Fusion Failed
fusion_failed.user_message: We couldn't merge content across multiple sources. Please retry the batch.

thumbnail_failed.title: Thumbnail Failed
thumbnail_failed.user_message: We couldn't generate a preview image for this file.
thumbnail_failed.action_hint: Ingestion can continue; retry later if a preview is needed.

embedding_failed.title: Embedding Failed
embedding_failed.user_message: We couldn't generate search embeddings for this module. Please retry.

search_metadata_failed.title: Search Metadata Failed
search_metadata_failed.user_message: A content generation step failed. Please retry the ingestion.

card_search_metadata_failed.title: Card Search Metadata Failed
card_search_metadata_failed.description: Per-card search metadata generation worker failed.
card_search_metadata_failed.user_message: A content generation step failed. Please retry the ingestion.

trigger_binding_failed.title: Trigger Binding Failed
trigger_binding_failed.user_message: A content generation step failed. Please retry the ingestion.

gap_classification_failed.title: Gap Classification Failed
gap_classification_failed.user_message: A content generation step failed. Please retry the ingestion.

quiz_generation_failed.title: Quiz Generation Failed
quiz_generation_failed.user_message: A content generation step failed. Please retry the ingestion.

enqueue_failed.title: Enqueue Failed
enqueue_failed.description: Failed to enqueue a follow-on pipeline or worker job.
enqueue_failed.user_message: A background task could not be started. Please retry the ingestion.
enqueue_failed.action_hint: Retry the ingestion from the admin dashboard.

module_has_no_text.title: Module Has No Text
module_has_no_text.description: Embedding or generation requires module text that is empty.
module_has_no_text.user_message: This module has no text content to process for the next step.
module_has_no_text.action_hint: Review the drafted module content before retrying.

generation_failed.title: Generation Failed
generation_failed.description: Generic AI generation step failed in a worker pipeline.
generation_failed.user_message: A content generation step failed. Please retry the ingestion.
